motif.name: cell
motif.note: Keep the cell recognisable by interval and placement. Do not quote it in every bar.

landmarks.role: frozen E/A, then the floor C

narrative.name: Opening identity
narrative.job: State the cell and the open fifth.

narrative.name: Counterpoint
narrative.job: Second voice enters late and leaves.

narrative.name: Harmonic destabilisation
narrative.job: Tritone and pentatonic collision, then hand the next tune its first note.

narrative.name: New melodic narrative
narrative.job: The line made from the cell, then the hinge that aims at the machine.

narrative.name: Liquid Harmony
narrative.job: Common-tone dyads. Do not paste the E arrangement over this.

narrative.name: Dramatic climax
narrative.job: Splinter, empty bar, chordal cell, failed reassembly, freeze, bass lead.

narrative.name: Transformed return
narrative.job: The cell again, F# refused as a long note, B chord after silence, D into the final F#.

seams.job: Wrong universe into the new tune
Bass lead into the return and the last F#

mci.continuity: The cell A–C#–B–E–F# stays recognisable at the opening, the tempo change, the fast section, and the return. The bass event stream, metre, rehearsal marks, protected guitar silences, and the final F# stay.
mci.innovation: Guitar writing changes only where this song needs a join: the wrong universe into the new tune, the hinge, the splinter, and the B chord after silence. A–H are read for ideas. Whole passages are not pasted.

cbv.note: No bass alternative is recommended. Proposals, when a later song lists any, stay reversible and are not written into the principal score.

radicalProfile.note: WWH starting profile for this song. Not a note-count quota.

gce.weakest: Bar 67 restated C#–B immediately after the cell in bars 65–66. One refinement: a rest, then the B chord. No second pass.
